## What changes for the user?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue when useful.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results. Explain any relevant checks you could not run. For interface changes, include screenshots and the narrow-screen or keyboard checks you performed.

## Data and integration impact

If relevant, describe changes to provider contracts, paid-call estimates, authentication, browser storage, exports, or migration behavior. Link the source of a changed provider contract.

Keep this PR free of API keys, session cookies, `.env` contents, and private audit data. Automated tests must use fixtures; live provider calls require an explicit spending budget. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
